title: How could AI benefit a Tamagotchi like game?
author: ARWorlds_umut
selftext:
Hi!

I'm exploring a Tamagotchi-like game with AI-powered mechanics. I'm curious how you guys think that AI can improve such a classic game.

Currently I'm thinking of the following mechanics that can be enhanced with AI:

1. Player pet sprite generation
2. Edit player sprite based on mood (sleep, sad, dead, etc.)
3. Pet sprites changing with each evolution
4.? Chatting with your pet (But I'm not sure what kind of purpose it'd have, especially for kids)
5. ???

Not sure what else makes sense. I'm curious if anyone has some fun ideas. Or is better not to disgrace tamagotchi.

Thanks!

comments.author: Trade-Deep
comments.body: this feels like too good an idea to not have been done already

replies.author: ARWorlds_umut
replies.body:
Haha, I was feeling the same. And cool repo thanks for sharing.

It's just that I can't think of an impactful improvement with LLMs that would benefit the genre. Do you have anything in mind?

replies.author: Trade-Deep
replies.body:
I like the idea of chatting with it.
Maybe teaching it to speak like with furbies

replies.author: ARWorlds_umut
replies.body: I had tried pokemon-like speech, maybe furbish is better

comments.author: Tomstachy
comments.body: Maybe something like creating a new feature for sending it on adventurers for resources and llm generates short description on what happened for extra lore.
